test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd number-pair.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option 1) 6 - 216

6³ = 216

216 = 216 (LHS = RHS)

Option 2) 9 - 729

93 = 729

729 = 729 (LHS = RHS)

Option 3) 7 - 343

73 = 343

343 = 343 (LHS = RHS)

Option 4) 8 - 256

83 = 256

**512 ≠ 256 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Thus, out of all the options '8 - 256' is the odd one out.

Hence,** "Option 4"** is the correct answer.
